_comment: Per-file byte ceilings for lifecycle SKILL.md bodies. Enforced by scripts/lint-skill-body-budget.py against the MERGE BASE, not the working tree: a working-tree read would let one diff raise both a file and its own ceiling and satisfy itself, which is how SKILL_DESCRIPTION_WORD_BUDGET reached 2442 after 15 bumps (counted 2026-09-18). Ceilings ratchet DOWN only -- lowering one never fails, raising one is a separate reviewed PR. Seeded at +10% headroom over the size at introduction, deliberately: a zero-headroom seed guarantees the first bump PR within a week, which reproduces the ritual this replaces. The row set is every key AND every destination in .claude/workflow-transitions.json (base and working tree) PLUS the sub-skills the lifecycle runs but the FSM does not model (ONE_SHOT_CHILD_SKILLS: deepen-plan, qa); plugins/soleur/test/workflow-fidelity.test.ts pins the keys here to exactly that union, so a skill added to the lifecycle cannot silently escape and a stale row cannot linger. See ADR-225 and #8302.
